scope: Lossless metadata lookup compression; compilation events and source evidence are retained.
invariants: Canonical numeric IDs use bounded chunk storage; every other ID remains an exact string key.
Every metadata field is preserved, including undefined versus empty URL and lone UTF-16 surrogates.
Later updates replace the same identity; distinct IDs do not alias.
Capacity exhaustion is explicit and invalidates observation.
All 250000 synthetic lookups are checked, not sampled.
All compilation events, order, counts and code hashes remain in the original compilation log.
limitations: The isolated memory measurement is heap growth plus ArrayBuffer growth, not process RSS or CI cost.
Insertion costs more than the ordinary Map in these samples.
Full-workload coverage and elapsed-time benefit remain unproven.

fullGate.alsoChanges: classified unavailable native captures and bounded failure call sites; memory checkpoints

reentrantCorrection.change: Validate owned data fields without invoking their getters, freeze the copy before allocating a dictionary slot, then re-read membership and capacities after any nested insertion. Capture used intrinsics and encode complete UTF-16 metadata with length prefixes rather than inherited toJSON hooks.
regressions: Nested insertion cannot alias two metadata slots.
Nested insertion rechecks entry capacity and updates to the same ID.
Later intrinsic replacements and inherited toJSON hooks do not execute.
Accessor metadata is rejected without invoking the getter; its failure stage is counted.
limitations: This fixes a reproducible nested-insertion hazard, but does not yet explain the prior full-run index errors.
The driver now requires failures=0 as well as count agreement and no overflow.
No production replay or savings claim changes.

pendingFullGate.alsoChanges: private native context bridge; guarded ordinary scalar owners; dense compilation run storage
